I added the three features to `Shop.Cart` in `lib/shop/cart.ex`, plus tests. All 17 tests pass, the code compiles with no warnings, and Credo (the Elixir linter) reports no issues in strict mode.

- **Removing items:** `remove_item(cart, sku, quantity)` takes units off an item. Removing as many units as the cart holds, or more, removes the item. Removing an item that isn't in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
